 【 Display 】 14-inch diagonal, HD (1366 x 768), micro-edge, BrightView, 220 nits, 45% NTSC
 【Wireless】 WiFi 802.11 + Bluetooth 5.4
 【Audio】 High Definition (HD) Audio, Stereo speakers

 1 x Multi-Format SD Media Card Reader

【Battery】 Up to 11 Hours
 【Color】 Natural Silver
 【Dimensions】 12.76 x 8.86 x 0.71
 【Weight】 3.24 lbs
 【Bundle】 1 x 1 Year Microsoft 365 Subsciption

items.label: Efficient Performance for Everyday Tasks
items.value: Powered by the New Generation Intel NI50 Processor and Intel Graphics, this 14-inch laptop delivers smooth performance for browsing, online classes, office tasks, and streaming. Windows 11 Home 64-bit provides a modern, intuitive interface to enhance productivity, huge amounts of storage mean you can save your entire multimedia library on your PC without compromise.

items: Elegant Natural Silver Design — Modern, clean and stylish, the sleek finish complements any workspace, ideal for students and young professionals. Lightweight and portable, its slim 14-inch body is easy to carry anywhere. The energy-efficient design provides long-lasting battery life for all-day use.

Equipped with 128GB High-Speed SSD Storage & extra 1TB Cloud Storage — Built-in 128GB solid state drive enables fast boot-up, quick app loading and smooth system operation with no mechanical noise and better shock resistance than traditional HDD. Meanwhile, the included 1TB online cloud storage provides safe space for backing up photos, videos, documents and important data.

items.label: Lightweight Design with All-Day Battery Life
items.value: Designed for mobility with a sleek Natural Silver chassis weighing just 3.24 lbs. Enjoy up to 11 hours of video playback or 7.5 hours of wireless streaming, making it ideal for school, travel, and everyday use.

items.label: Enhanced Video Calls & Smart Input Features
items.value: Stay clear and confident in virtual meetings with the HP True Vision 720p HD camera featuring temporal noise reduction and dual array microphones. Includes a full-size keyboard with a dedicated Microsoft Copilot key and a multi-touch HP Imagepad for effortless navigation.

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
items.value: Anti Glare Coating, HD Audio, Memory Card Slot, Spill Resistant

items.label: Compatible Devices
items.value: External displays, mice, keyboards, storage devices, printers, and other accessories with USB, HDMI, USB-C, or wireless connectivity options.
